runs.text: The bookshop has this rule: a student who spends 10 pesos or more gets a 10 % discount; whoever has a birthday that day gets 15 %; if both apply, the larger one wins. Place each customer in their discount.

A decision table with three rows (student, spending 10 or more, birthday) puts the five cases in order. The birthday always wins when it applies, because it is the larger; the 10 % needs both conditions at once.
Not a student, spends 5, no birthday
